thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service= inference-gateway (eu-west1) — sudden 5xx spike (502/504). Error rate 1m: 4.8% (>3% threshold). Link: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/1769008888 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): ack'd — I'm taking initial triage, pinging infra and routing to see scope.

sam: seeing similar in cloudwatch, origin upstream showing surge of 502s around 16:22 UTC.

jen: any recent rollout to edge-proxy? I can roll back if needed.

alex (oncall): not aware of any canary, but there was a config push 16:15 for keepalive tuning. rolling back looks reasonable if we confirm correlation.

ops-bot: deploy bot: deploy-1234 completed at 16:14 by ci/cd (keepalive-tweak).

alex (oncall): running quick checks — listing pods and recent logs.

ops-bot: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=app=inference-gateway
NAME                                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-gateway-5c9bd7f6d9-abc12           2/2     Running   0          3d
inference-gateway-5c9bd7f6d9-def34           1/2     CrashLoop 6          2h
inference-gateway-5c9bd7f6d9-ghi56           2/2     Running   0          3d
```

alex (oncall): def34 is showing restarts, tailing logs now. Suspect connection pooling regression from keepalive change.

sam: if it's pooling maybe upstream overload — can we temporarily route traffic away from eu-west1 to eu-west2 for non-SLA customers?

jen: +1 to partial reroute. If we shift 25% of traffic off eu-west1 via routing policy, we can reduce pressure while we fix.

alex (oncall): initiating canary reroute 25% for best-effort tiers now.

ops-bot: routing change applied: traffic-split inference-gateway: eu-west1=75% eu-west2=25% (policy-id: rs-2026-16) — takes ~30s to propagate.

natalie: monitoring shows error rate dropping to 2.1% in eu-west1 after reroute. Customer-facing errors reduced.

sam: good signal. We should still rollback keepalive tweak in the next 10m to fully stabilize.

alex (oncall): agreed. rolling back deploy-1234 to previous revision. Triggering rollback now.

ops-bot: rollback started: deploy-1234 -> deploy-1233. ```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway -n inference --to-revision=1233
```

alex (oncall): watching pod restarts — def34 coming up healthy.

ops-bot: pod def34 now 2/2 Ready. Logs show upstream connection errors stopped.

incident-bot: Alert update: error rate eu-west1 5xx 1m now 0.9% — below threshold. Pager chain auto-resolved.

jen: nice quick work. Any customer impact SLA hits?

alex (oncall): initial impact window ~16:21–16:30 UTC. Estimated affected requests ~0.4% of total for that window, mainly non-enterprise traffic. No persistent data loss.

natalie: flagged support to proactively message any customers who reported 502s; adding note to incident timeline.

sam: will follow up with a short postmortem note on root cause: keepalive change caused fewer upstream connections to get recycled leading to overloaded origins under burst. Proposed fix: revert tuning and add upstream circuit breaker/queue limits + e2e load test.

alex (oncall): handing off to night_oncall for monitoring and post-rollback checks. Summary: 5xx spike caused by recent keepalive tweak deploy-1234; rollback to 1233 restored stability; partial traffic reroute used to mitigate during rollback. No major customer SLA breaches. See runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/inference/keepalive-502

night_oncall: acked — taking it through the night, will watch eu-west1 for 2h and escalate if error rate rises >1.5% sustained. Thanks for the handoff. :thumbsup:

alex (oncall): dropping a short timeline and labels into incident-log for search: tags=[5xx,eu-west1,rollback,keepalive,pgd-2026].

incident-bot: Incident closed (automated) — duration 9 minutes. Logs and timeline saved to https://incidents/redwood/1769008888

natalie: prepping support note and small customer comms, will post draft in #support for review.

jen: follow-up action item in backlog: add canary traffic-shift playbook and preflight checks for keepalive changes.

sam: +1 — will create ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

alex (oncall): thanks team.
